defect: generated shift-register stages can resemble an off-by-one array access
rationale: Depth is a positive design parameter, stage zero captures the input, and the second loop only copies from stage i-1 for i in 1 through Depth-1. Every output access is therefore within the stage array.

provenance.adaptation: Inlined the small gated shift-register behavior used by the wrapper and reduced it to a typed data array.

mutation.description: A parameterized sequential loop uses adjacent array elements and explicit reset/clear handling.
